assets.name: Monogramme
assets.description: Une signature compacte et affirmée, proche de ton KZ actuel.
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one premium 3D personal logo concept, a standalone transparent cutout for a personal website and social avatar.
Primary request: create an original KZ logo with the same tactile, chunky, refined miniature-object rendering as the reference.
Input image 1 is ONLY a materials, lighting and 3D finish reference. Ignore all reference objects, UI, labels, cards and backgrounds. Do not copy robots or sports equipment.
Text (verbatim): "KZ". Exactly the uppercase Latin letters K and Z, in that reading order, clearly identifiable. No other text.
Style/medium: beautifully art-directed solid 3D object, substantial softened bevels, premium matte graphite anodized material, satin ivory faces, subtle Lagon cyan #3FB0C2 physical inlays. Soft studio light from upper left, gentle edge light, realistic subtle ambient occlusion within the object. No chrome or mirror metal. Restrained palette, pleasing compact silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent alpha background, completely isolated. No ground plane, no floor shadow, no opaque backdrop, no haze or glow surrounding the silhouette. Cyan accents must be solid inset material, not atmospheric bloom; external neon will be added separately in CSS.
Composition: single centered emblem, square image, complete object visible with generous transparent margin. Nearly front view with a very slight elevated three-quarter rotation so the depth reads but both letters remain readable at small sizes. No mockup, no contact sheet, no captions or extra symbols.
Concept 01 — SIGNATURE MONOGRAM. Sculpt the two uppercase letters KZ into a compact bespoke interlocking typographic mark. A bold upright K at left and bold angular Z at right, nest them closely with a consistent narrow negative-space channel so each letter reads immediately. Slight forward energy like a refined athletic signature, not a generic typeset word. Broad warm ivory front faces, substantial graphite extrusion with softly rounded corners, a single slender cyan inset strip visible along one diagonal side bevel. The monogram itself is the entire object: absolutely no enclosing plaque, badge, frame, base or pedestal. Elegant balanced negative spaces, strong large-format typography.
